title: Routed SwiGLU experts over a slot store of expert bundles on BF16 tensor cores, every stored format, decode rows and prompt chunks with the same bits

decode.what: items of 8 routes (decode rows): a warp owns row tiles of one expert, 4-bit codes decoded through a shared byte table, the routes' operands read straight from global memory, weights DEPTH blocks ahead

WARPS.what: warps a block, each owning TILES row tiles of one expert

TILES.what: MMA row tiles a warp owns (gate/up: 8 inter rows each, down: 16 output rows), sharing each B fragment

DEPTH.what: 64-k blocks of weights in flight a warp (0: the format's depth, 2-6 by format and tiles)

yardstick.library: FlashInfer grouped GEMM (flashinfer.grouped_mm.grouped_mm_bf16, cuDNN MoE backend) on the pass's weights widened to BF16 once, the routes' inputs gathered in expert order and (gate/up) the SwiGLU in torch: no library takes every stored format against BF16 inputs one pass at a time

prompt.what: items of 32 routes (prompt chunks): the routes' operands staged in shared memory by cp.async, the next chunk landing while the current one computes; each weight fragment feeds four n-tiles

WARPS.what: warps a block, each owning TILES row tiles of one expert

TILES.what: MMA row tiles a warp owns (gate/up: 8 inter rows each, down: 16 output rows), sharing each B fragment

DEPTH.what: 64-k blocks of weights in flight a warp (0: the format's depth, 2-6 by format and tiles)

CHUNK.what: k values of the item's inputs staged a pass by cp.async (two halves of shared memory, at most 48 KiB)

yardstick.library: FlashInfer grouped GEMM (flashinfer.grouped_mm.grouped_mm_bf16, cuDNN MoE backend) on the pass's weights widened to BF16 once, the routes' inputs gathered in expert order and (gate/up) the SwiGLU in torch: no library takes every stored format against BF16 inputs one pass at a time

prompt-wide.what: items of 64 routes (Workspace(width=64)): as prompt, each weight fragment decoded once for eight n-tiles

WARPS.what: warps a block, each owning TILES row tiles of one expert

TILES.what: MMA row tiles a warp owns (gate/up: 8 inter rows each, down: 16 output rows), sharing each B fragment

DEPTH.what: 64-k blocks of weights in flight a warp (0: the format's depth, 2-6 by format and tiles)

CHUNK.what: k values of the item's inputs staged a pass by cp.async (two halves of shared memory, at most 48 KiB)

yardstick.library: FlashInfer grouped GEMM (flashinfer.grouped_mm.grouped_mm_bf16, cuDNN MoE backend) on the pass's weights widened to BF16 once, the routes' inputs gathered in expert order and (gate/up) the SwiGLU in torch: no library takes every stored format against BF16 inputs one pass at a time

declared.what: crit's integer block order (nvfp4 W4A4, int4 W4A8) for the CPU tier's bits: a half-warp per output row, dp4a block sums, the halving tree; the declared quantizers and SwiGLU

plan-combine.what: the routes grouped by expert (a one-block bitonic sort up to 1,024 routes, items from a stable sort beyond) and each token's routes summed in route order
